title: 'Contemptuous' Conduct: Why Allahabad High Court Cancelled Stalking-Accused Advocate's Interim Bail, Ordered Bar Council Inquiry
description: The Allahabad High Court on Monday cancelled the interim bail of an advocate accused of harassing and stalking a lady colleague while observing that his acts of writing directly to the judge's chamber and showing up in open court in violation of his explicit undertaking were "contemptuous and wholly unprofessional".
